title: Disney Just Turned Its Biggest Animated Hit Into a Live-Action Blockbuster. India Gets It July 10.
excerpt: The live-action Moana brings Dwayne Johnson back as Maui, introduces a stunning new lead, and arrives with a bombshell: Moana 3 is already in the works.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Disney's live-action Moana releases in India on July 10 in English and Hindi.
  • Dwayne Johnson reprises his role as Maui, alongside newcomer Catherine Laga'aia as Moana.
  • Lin-Manuel Miranda wrote a new duet for the film, featuring both Moana actresses.
  • Moana 3 is officially in development, with the original writers returning.
  • The film aims for an $85 million opening weekend in the US.

Somewhere between the animated sequel earning a billion dollars and Dwayne Johnson casually confirming a third film at a press conference in Rio, Moana stopped being a franchise and became an empire.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=n7f6hlKsxxo

Now the empire is going live-action — and it's heading to Indian cinemas on July 10 in both English and Hindi.

A New Moana, the Same Ocean

Disney's live-action Moana retells the original 2016 story: a chief's daughter, chosen by the ocean, sails across the Pacific to restore the heart of Te Fiti and save her island. Same bones, but the flesh is entirely new.

Catherine Laga'aia, an 18-year-old Australian-Samoan actress making her feature film debut, steps into the title role — and if the early footage is any indication, she doesn't just play Moana. She *is* Moana. Director Thomas Kail (the man behind the original *Hamilton* staging) has said it took him "about ten seconds" after meeting her to know she was the one.

Dwayne Johnson returns as Maui, the demigod with the tattoos and the ego, reprising the role he voiced in both animated films. This time, he's in the flesh — and he's already having the time of his life on the global press tour, performing "You're Welcome" live in Sydney and charming audiences from London to São Paulo.

> "This time, he's in the flesh — and he's already having the time of his life on the global press tour, performing "You're Welcome" live in Sydney and charming audiences from London to São Paulo."

The supporting cast is quietly excellent: Jemaine Clement (of Flight of the Conchords fame) returns as the giant crab Tamatoa, Rena Owen brings gravitas as Gramma Tala, and John Tui and Frankie Adams round out Moana's family.

Lin-Manuel Miranda Wrote a New Song — and It's a Duet

The musical dimension might be the most emotionally charged piece of the puzzle. Lin-Manuel Miranda has composed a brand-new original song for the live-action version called "Along the Way." The twist? It's a duet featuring both Auliʻi Cravalho (the original animated Moana) and Catherine Laga'aia singing together — a passing of the torch wrapped in a melody.

![Dwayne Johnson — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7e/Dwayne_Johnson-1764_%284x5_cropped_with_moderate_headroom%29.jpg)

> "Auliʻi and Catherine's voices blend so beautifully, and writing for Dwayne as Maui is just pure fun. I'm grateful that we were able to create something special for this brand-new version of our wayfinder's story." — Lin-Manuel Miranda

The rest of the soundtrack brings back Miranda, Opetaia Foaʻi, and Mark Mancina — the trio behind the original's Grammy-nominated score. Mancina has also composed the film's orchestral score.

The Moana 3 Bombshell

Moana's Cinematic Journey

2021

July 10, 2023

Moana 3 officially announced, writers from previous films returning.

During a press conference in Rio de Janeiro this week, Dwayne Johnson dropped the news everyone was waiting for: Moana 3 is officially in the works.

"Yes, we have talked about Moana 3, yes," Johnson said, before noting that writers Jared Bush and Dana Ledoux Miller — who penned both previous films — will write the screenplay. No release date yet, no director confirmed, but the intent is clear: Disney isn't done with this ocean.

Given the franchise's track record — the first film grossed $687 million, the sequel cleared $1.059 billion — the question isn't whether Moana 3 will happen. It's whether the audience has appetite for this much Moana this fast. The live-action, animated sequel, and now a third animated film represent three versions of the same world within a few years.

What the Diaspora Should Know

The live-action Moana releases in India on July 10 in English and Hindi, making it one of the rare Hollywood tentpoles arriving day-and-date with the US. For Indian families in the diaspora, this is an easy weekend pick — visually gorgeous, musically rich, and short enough at 120 minutes to keep the kids engaged without testing parental endurance.

It's also releasing the same week as Ikka and Dhamaal 4 — so the July 10 corridor is shaping up to be one of the most packed release dates of the year. Disney is betting that Moana's brand is strong enough to hold its own against Bollywood heavyweights. Tracking suggests an $85 million opening weekend in the US, which would be solid if not spectacular.

The film will be theatres-only for at least two months before eventually landing on Disney+, so if you want to see Maui on the big screen — and let's be honest, he deserves a big screen — this is your window.

July 10. In cinemas. The ocean is calling — again.
